_comment: ADock fitted scoring function (linear in weights over per-term features; see src/adock/fit/terms.py). Energy units: Vina-like kcal/mol per unit feature; no 1/(1+w*Nrot) factor in ranking.
status: Selected 2026-10-26 by val-select docking (engine v2_default, seeds 0,1; pooled val_plinder val_select holo+AF and val_af_post2023 AF). Cycle-0 fit (Vina+Vinardo decoys, fit+fit_af). Val-confirm (once, seed 0): not significantly better than stock Vina on v2_default (+2.8 pts, 95% CI -1.9..+7.4). See reports/scoring_fit.md.

units.energy: Vina-like kcal/mol per unit feature (ranking only; no 1/(1+w*Nrot) factor)
units.ionic: positive weight = attraction between opposite formal charges; feature q_l*q_a*(1/r^2-1/rc^2), r clamped at ion_rmin (A)
units.buried_threshold: receptor heavy atoms within buried_radius (A) of the receptor atom
units.others: Vina basis functions of the surface distance d=r-R_l-R_a (A); *_buried/hbond_*/metal_acceptor/polar_apolar/gauss1_buried are additive extras on subsets of pairs (src/adock/fit/terms.py INTER_TERMS)

run: python -m adock.fit.fdock --receptor R.pdb --ligand L.sdf --box box.json --out poses.sdf  (or adock.dock mode 'v2_fitted')
